trips.route_note: Take a long-distance bus or shared taxi from Muscat's Ruwi bus station on the highway to Nizwa, then walk or take a short taxi into the old town and fort area.
trips.why: The long-distance bus from Ruwi runs on the highway and drops you near the old town, with a short taxi for the last mile.
know: Nizwa Fort and the Friday goat market are the main draws; the market is best early Friday morning
The fort can have reduced hours on Fridays, so check before going
Summer afternoons are very hot; go in the cooler months or early in the day

trips.route_note: Buses and shared taxis run along the coast road from Muscat toward Barka; get off in town and take a local taxi to the fort and waterfront.
